certificate.family: near-plugins v0.5.1 Upgradable (commit 312e016e); reference vault contract built with the plugin
certificate.statement: In the Lean model of the plugin: a successful up_deploy_code deploys exactly the code of the last up_stage_code, no earlier than the staging time plus the staging duration in force when it was staged; between staging and deploy up_staged_code_hash is constant and is the only hash a deploy accepts; no deploy is accepted before safeUntil = min(now + D, staging timestamp of staged code, effect time of a pending duration change plus its value), and this bound is tight; with no duration set, staging and an accepted deploy can share one block timestamp. This wasm conforms to the model on the kit's traces.
assumptions: Conformance of the wasm to the model is tested on 6000 traces, not proved for all inputs.
The build has overflow checks on (a separate lower bound is proved for builds without them).
Code-change paths outside the plugin (access keys, custom upgrade methods, global contracts by account id) are not covered and must be checked separately.
That a user's exit completes within the window is a hypothesis about the host contract, not proved here.
